purpose: One visible month of a Calendar: the weekday row over the weeks of day cells, Sunday first, marking the chosen days by Mode.

notFor.case: Standalone use without the header and selection logic.
A grid of activity over many weeks.

Default.meaning: No states of its own; each day carries its own (CalendarDay).
Default.visual: Weekday names in Content/secondary over the CalendarDay grid.

a11y.role: grid of day buttons (date picker dialog, APG)
a11y.keyboard: One day is the tab stop (the selection, else today, else the first enabled day). Arrow Left / Right move one day, Arrow Up / Down one week, skipping disabled days; Enter or Space selects.
notes: The weekday row is plain text.

openQuestions: Keyboard: should Page Up / Page Down change month and Home / End jump to the week's start and end, as the APG date grid does?
Week start: the month is Sunday first. Should the first day follow the locale?
